title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Brings a Global War, Captain Price and a New DMZ Experience
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is preparing for launch with a global conflict, Captain Price's return, a major multiplayer experience and the return of DMZ.
content:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is preparing to launch as one of the biggest entries in the series, bringing players into a new global conflict led by Infinity Ward.

The story begins with a full-scale invasion of South Korea that threatens to destabilize the world. Players will experience the conflict from multiple perspectives, including Private Park, a young South Korean soldier fighting on the front lines, and Captain Price, who is operating outside the system on a personal mission.

The campaign will take players across several major locations, including Korea, New York, Paris and Mumbai. The story combines large-scale warfare with close-quarters combat, high-speed chases and covert operations.

Modern Warfare 4 will also introduce a major multiplayer experience. At launch, players will have access to 12 brand-new 6v6 maps designed around different locations and combat situations. The game focuses on precise gunplay, fluid movement and greater control during firefights.

One of the biggest additions is the return of DMZ. Players can deploy alone or with a squad, explore dangerous combat zones, complete objectives, collect valuable technology and attempt to extract before enemies take them down.

The game also features large-scale multiplayer maps with vehicle and infantry combat, giving players more ways to fight across the battlefield.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is scheduled to release worldwide on October 23, 2026. The game will be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2. It will not release on PlayStation 4 or Xbox One.

faq.question: When will Modern Warfare 4 release?
faq.answer: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is scheduled to release worldwide on October 23, 2026.

faq.question: Who is developing Modern Warfare 4?
faq.answer: Modern Warfare 4 is being developed by Infinity Ward with support from other Activision studios.

faq.question: Will Captain Price return?
faq.answer: Yes. Captain Price returns as one of the central characters in the campaign.

faq.question: How many multiplayer maps will be available at launch?
faq.answer: Modern Warfare 4 will launch with 12 new 6v6 multiplayer maps.

faq.question: What is DMZ in Modern Warfare 4?
faq.answer: DMZ is an extraction-focused experience where players enter dangerous combat zones, complete objectives, collect valuable equipment and attempt to escape.

faq.question: Which platforms will Modern Warfare 4 support?
faq.answer: Modern Warfare 4 will be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch 2.

faq.question: Will Modern Warfare 4 release on PS4 or Xbox One?
faq.answer: No. Modern Warfare 4 is being released for current-generation platforms and will not launch on PS4 or Xbox One.
